channel.title: NEWS & LOGS
channel.description: Sakura ARC Official News & Logs. From the latest updates to production philosophy.

item.title: 「フォトリアルノベル」とは？AIと実写背景が融合する次世代のエンタメミステリー | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: Sakura ARCが提唱する新ジャンル「フォトリアルノベル（Photoreal Novel）」について解説します。実際の風景写真とAI生成技術を組み合わせた、没入感あふれる新しいビジュアルノベルの形をご提案します。

item.title: Steam 'Kamiya Detective Agency' Coming Soon Page Approved & Multi-Language Support Launched | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: We are thrilled to announce that the Steam Coming Soon page for our upcoming mystery game, 'Kamiya Detective Agency,' has passed platform review. We also introduce the official trailer, website (supporting JA/EN/ZH), and plans for 18-language support.

item.title: AI Agent Updates My Site Faster Than SNS! —— Antigravity × GitHub Pages | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: I found it easier to have an AI agent update my own site than posting to SNS. The new strategy for individual development using Antigravity and GitHub Pages.

item.title: Sakura ARC's Creative Stance | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: To the global platform of Steam. About the future creative stance of Sakura ARC and the reasons for utilizing AI.
